conventions.population: error_type == 'crash' excluded from every pair (counted in inputs); 'limit' scored
conventions.handoff_flag: the prefix arm's handoff_occurred; missing counts as silenced (h = 0) and is counted
conventions.clusterings: scenario (19) primary, task (57) secondary; percentile int(0.025 B), int(0.975 B)
conventions.p_two_sided: 2 x smaller tail share of the scenario bootstrap statistic at threshold_pp (j10_report.bootstrap_pvalue); p_signflip_two_sided is cluster_inference.registered_signflip over scenarios at the same threshold
conventions.units: *_pp in percentage points; means, ratios, shares, qrec and savings in native units
